Definition: Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Naarah or Naarath = "maiden"; n pr f; 1) the 2nd wife of Ashur of the tribe of Judah; n pr loc; 2) one of the landmarks on the southern boundary of the territory of Ephraim
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
